mapper.sql: greatest( process.started_at, coalesce(( select max(run.updated_at) from runs run join sessions session_row on session_row.session_id = run.session_id where coalesce(run.triggered_by_user_id, session_row.created_by_user_id) = process.user_id ), process.started_at) )

process.process_id, process.user_id, process.linux_server_id, process.container_id, process.port, process.pid, process.base_url, process.status, process.session_path, process.config_path, process.started_at, process.last_health_check_at, process.health_message, process.created_at, process.updated_at, process.trace_id, as last_activity_at

from opencode_server_processes process join user_opencode_process_bindings binding on binding.process_id = process.process_id and binding.user_id = process.user_id and binding.linux_server_id = process.linux_server_id and binding.port = process.port and binding.agent_id = 'opencode' and binding.status = 'ACTIVE' where process.status in ('RUNNING', 'UNHEALTHY') and < #{activityBefore}
